notes.title: Demo version 0.6.1 is now avaible on Steam !
notes.notes:
Finally, the Cemetery of Bob demo is available on Steam. If you like what you see, consider adding game to your wishlist. Feedback is really appreciated.

If you have any suggestions, you can post them on Discord: https://discord.gg/FqSef679pM

There is also good news for the Linux community. From now on, Cemetery of Bob will be supported by native Linux builds.

Demo version 0.6.1 features:
- 2 stages
- 7 unique undeads
- 6 unique human enemies
- 8 unique mythical enemies
- 16 unique items
- 6 cutscenes
- endless mode
